newsitem.title: USA: Integral Systems delays holders meeting.
newsitem.headline: Integral Systems delays holders meeting.

text.p: Integral Systems Inc said Friday that its annual shareholders' meeting, originally scheduled for April 3, 1997, has been rescheduled to June 4.
As previously announced, the company is planning to solicit proxies to approve an increase in shares in conjunction with a three-for-one stock split.
The company said in a release that it has retained outside counsel to assist it in connection with its planned stock split and related disclosure materials.
